# Global Electronics & Test-Measurement

Geography

Global footprint across Americas, Europe, and APAC

Enterprise Accessibility at Scale Global Electronics & Test-Measurement Leader

- Varied accessibility maturity across teams and product groups.
- No unified WCAG-aligned standards for design, engineering, and content.
- Rising regulatory and customer expectations for inclusive digital experiences.
- Limited internal capabilities to support accessibility at scale.

### Our Approach

Performed enterprise maturity and gap assessment across digital assets.

Logged and tracked 1,000+ accessibility issues in Jira with ownership and severity tagging.

Ran prioritized remediation cycles integrated into Agile sprints.

Used Site improve scores to baseline and monitor compliance improvements.

- Improved WCAG A compliance by 25% and AA compliance by 10% within initial sprint cycles.
- Introduced standardized accessibility practices adopted across global teams.
- Developed an AEM-based accessibility accelerator, enabling shift-left prevention of issues in both code and content workflows.
